title: The Metaphysical Questions to Be Developed from the Fundamental Attunement of Profound Boredom
part: Part Two — Really Asking the Metaphysical Questions to Be Developed from the Fundamental Attunement of Profound Boredom. The Question: What Is World?
source: Martin Heidegger, The Fundamental Concepts of Metaphysics: World, Finitude, Solitude (GA 29/30), trans. William McNeill & Nicholas Walker, Indiana University Press, 1995
structural_role: Part One → Part Two hinge: profound boredom (analyzed in fcm-06/07) releases the three metaphysical questions (world, individuation, finitude); the essence of time is named as their common root; Part Two ("What is world?") is the cashing-out of the boredom analysis, not a new topic.
loci_policy: triple locus (p.NN / GA pp.NN / pdf NN); GA read from running heads (non-linear drift), pdf = floor((book_page+24)/2)

objects.name: profound boredom
objects.definition: The fundamental attunement (Grundstimmung) whose telling refusal of beings as a whole gives the three metaphysical questions to be questioned; analyzed in fcm-06/07 and here carried forward as the releasing ground of Part Two, not left behind as a finished fact.
objects.anchor_phrase: profound boredom properly and really gives us to question

objects.name: What is world?
objects.definition: The first of the three questions. World is the name Heidegger gives to the expanse of the 'as a whole' (im Ganzen) that manifests itself in profound boredom; Part Two is dedicated to asking it.
objects.anchor_phrase: the expanse of this 'as a whole' ... as world

objects.name: What is individuation?
objects.definition: The question concerning the individuation of Dasein with respect to itself, announced in the moment of vision (Augenblick) that the telling refusal simultaneously discloses; the singular, unique existing that the situation seizes upon.
objects.anchor_phrase: the individuation of Dasein with respect to itself

objects.name: What is finitude?
objects.definition: The question concerning the rupture (by the moment of vision) of the entrancing horizon's expanse, in which Dasein attains its existence proper; named as the third and pressing question, but the most originary one that holds the other two together, hence placed in the middle of the series.
objects.anchor_phrase: We call this the finitude of Dasein

objects.name: the essence of time as the root of the three questions
objects.definition: Profound boredom (and boredom as such) is rooted in the temporality of Dasein; thus the three questions reach back into the question concerning the essence of time, which is the origin of all questions of metaphysics and equals the question of being (Being and Time).
objects.anchor_phrase: rooted in the temporality of Dasein

objects.name: as a whole
objects.definition: The expanse pressing in upon Dasein on every side that manifests itself in profound boredom; what 'world' names. The absence of any oppressiveness as a whole is what ought to oppress us.
objects.anchor_phrase: this 'as a whole' presses in upon us

objects.name: telling refusal of beings as a whole
objects.definition: The structural moment of being left empty in profound boredom: beings as a whole withdraw yet in that very refusal announce. It is the announcing-that-refuses and refusing-that-announces unity from which world and individuation arise.
objects.anchor_phrase: telling refusal that announces, this telling announcement that refuses

objects.name: moment of vision
objects.definition: The look of resolute disclosedness of Dasein for its Da-sein, an existing always singular and unique; announced in the telling refusal and rupturing the entrancing horizon, so that Dasein attains its existence proper precisely in this rupture. Misinterpreted by contemporary man as the speed of his reactions.
objects.anchor_phrase: look of resolute disclosedness of Dasein for its Da-sein

objects.name: rupture (of the entrancing horizon)
objects.definition: The breaking of the expanse of the entrancing horizon by the moment of vision; the meaning of this rupture within Dasein is named finitude. The essence of the unity and structural linking of expanse and extremity is itself ultimately a rupture.
objects.anchor_phrase: ruptured by the moment of vision

objects.name: expanse and extremity (horizon and moment of vision)
objects.definition: The paired terms whose necessary relation profound boredom gives to be questioned: horizon (expanse, world) and moment of vision (extremity, individuation); their structural link is the 'and' whose necessity grounds the questions.
objects.anchor_phrase: between 'expanse' and 'extremity'

objects.name: the ultimate demand upon man
objects.definition: The necessity, announced together with the absence of oppressiveness, that man shoulder his very Dasein once more and explicitly take it upon himself; the liberation of the Dasein in man as a task and an actual burden.
objects.anchor_phrase: the ultimate demand [Zumutung] upon man

objects.name: Da-sein / liberation of the Dasein in man
objects.definition: The being-there that individuation discloses; the evocation (not description) of the Dasein in man is the task given over to philosophizing, achievable only from out of the ground of each one's essence.
objects.anchor_phrase: to evoke the Dasein in man

objects.name: philosophizing leads only to the brink of possibility
objects.definition: Philosophizing is penultimate: it can lead Dasein to the brink of its possibilities but only individual action (the moment of vision) can leap from possibility into actuality; the questioning must form its own interrogative space in the act of questioning.
objects.anchor_phrase: always remains something penultimate

objects.name: the three questions express the fundamental question of metaphysics (Being and Time)
objects.definition: The temporality of Dasein, and thus the essence of time, is the root of the three questions which together express the fundamental question of metaphysics, the question concerning being — Being and Time.
objects.anchor_phrase: the question concerning being: Being and Time

objects.name: essential questions: neither new nor old
objects.definition: Because they are rooted in the need of our Dasein, the three questions are genuine; being genuine they are not new, but not old either — they are essential questions, indifferent to mere striving after originality.
objects.anchor_phrase: Neither new nor old, these questions are essential questions

objects.name: finitude placed in the middle as the originary root
objects.definition: Posed first as world/finitude/individuation, the questions are reordered so that finitude — the unifying and original root holding the other two together — stands in the middle; yet in the order of treatment it can be engaged only in third place.
objects.anchor_phrase: the unifying and original root of the other two

objects.name: beleaguering of the questions by tradition and common sense
objects.definition: The three questions are beleaguered both by the philosophical tradition (philosophia perennis as common sense's external organizing scheme) and by sound common sense; both forces level down the questioning and rob it of its edge. The more familiar and self-evident the object, the more essential the question.
objects.anchor_phrase: find themselves beleaguered by the tradition and sound common sense

objects.name: historicity of philosophizing
objects.definition: Great philosophy moves within a few questions that appear perennially the same yet are necessarily different in every instance; the self-same is each time essentially transformed, and this transformation lends a primordial historicity to the history of philosophizing, distinct from newspaper-history.
objects.anchor_phrase: a properly primordial historicity to the occurrence

objects.name: philosophia perennis (ordinary understanding's construct)
objects.definition: The very idea of a philosophia perennis is, for Heidegger, merely a means by which ordinary understanding organizes the history of philosophy from a standpoint outside philosophy, seeking an impossible self-sameness and otherwise treating that history as a madhouse.
objects.anchor_phrase: the very idea of the philosophia perennis

objects.name: Augenblick
objects.definition: Lit. 'glance of the eye'; the moment of vision — resolute disclosedness, the instantaneous look in which Dasein seizes its singular situation. Here glossed as the extremity (Spitze) opposed to the horizon's expanse.
objects.anchor_phrase: moment of vision

bridge_relevance: The hinge supplies the warrant for the King–Salvo bridge's deepest move: profound boredom is not a measurable feeling-state but the temporally-rooted attunement that gives world/finitude/individuation to be questioned. Time as the common root licenses reading the team's time-dilation self-reports (2023 physiological pilot) as the phenomenal signature of the long-while, and the demand to 'really ask' rather than level-down warrants treating the engaged-yet-bored cross-instrument split as a structural disclosure rather than measurement noise.
